messages:
Tom H: Hey folks, tiny onboarding snag  trying to add my weekly 'team sync notes' and a small runbook to Notion. Where do we keep stuff that everyone on eng can edit?
Maya (DevEx): Welcome Tom! :wave: Put collaborative docs under Docs  eng  <team-name>. Runbooks go in eng-infra or eng depending on owner. For general notes you can create a page in your team space so it appears in the sidebar.
Tom H: I copied the 'Weekly Sync' template into my private area. How do I change it so the rest of the team can edit (not just view)?
Priya: Duplicate it in your private space if needed, then Move -> select "eng / <team-name>". After moving: Share -> invite eng@redwood.com -> set to "Can edit". If "Move" is blocked you'll see "You don't have permission to move this page".
Tom H: I hit that exact error. The template is owned by another team.
Maya (DevEx): Two quick fixes: (A) Ask the page owner to transfer or duplicate into your space. (B) File a Docs Ops ticket and they can transfer it while preserving history. If you want Docs Ops to handle it, reply here and we'll open ticket DOC-xxx.
Tom H: Please open a ticket, prefer to keep comments/history. Page id: 78ac9b.
docs-bot: DOC-947 created: "Transfer: Weekly Sync template -> eng/<team-name>". Assignee: Docs Ops. https://tickets.redwood.com/DOC-947
Priya: Once it's moved, also set the page property "Visibility" to Team so it shows up in the left nav for everyone. And don't paste secrets in Notion use vault links instead.
Tom H: Good call on the vault. Thanks for the quick help! One last q: where is the canonical template index so I can add feedback?
Maya (DevEx): Templates canonical index: Docs  Templates  Team templates. To propose changes copy the template into the Templates workspace and open a PR in the Templates tracker (link at top of that page) or ping #devex with the page link.
Tom H: Perfect, closing the loop. Appreciate it :pray:
